q: How did the angel say this would happen since Mary was a virgin?
a: The angel said that the Holy Spirit would come upon Mary and the power of the Most High would overshadow her.

q: What was it Zechariah prophesied that his child John would help the people to know?
a: John would help the people know how they could be saved through the forgiveness of their sins.

q: What did the Holy Spirit reveal to Simeon?
a: The Holy Spirit revealed to Simeon that he would not die before he saw the Lord’s Christ.

q: What message did John preach throughout the region around the Jordan River?
a: John preached a baptism of repentance for the forgiveness of sins.

q: John told the people that he baptized with water. With what did he say that someone was coming would baptize?
a: John said someone was coming who would baptize with the Holy Spirit and with fire.

q: Why did John rebuke Herod?
a: John rebuked Herod because Herod had married his own brother’s wife and had done many other evil things.

q: In the synagogue, what did the demon speaking through the man know about Jesus?
a: The demon said that he knew Jesus was the Holy One of God.

q: How did the people react after Jesus cast out the demon?
a: The people were astonished and kept talking about it with one another.

q: What did the demons say as they were cast out, and why did Jesus not let them speak?
a: The demons said that Jesus was the Son of God, and Jesus did not let them speak because they knew he was the Christ.

q: How did the centurion then want Jesus to heal the slave?
a: The centurion then wanted Jesus to heal the slave by just saying a word.

q: What accusation was made against John the Baptizer because he did not eat bread or drink wine?
a: They said, “He has a demon.”

q: What did the woman of the city do to Jesus in the Pharisee’s house?
a: She wet Jesus’ feet with her tears, wiped them with her hair, kissed his feet, and anointed his feet with perfumed oil.

q: What did the demons cause the man from the region of the Gerasenes to do?
a: They made him live without clothes in the tombs, they made him break chains and shackles, and they often drove him into the wilderness.

q: Before Jesus cast out the demon, what did it cause the man’s son to do?
a: The demon caused him to cry out and have convulsions with foam.

q: By what power did Jesus answer that he drove out demons?
a: He said he drove out demons by the finger of God.

q: What were the people doing in the days of Noah?
a: They were eating, drinking, marrying, and giving in marriage, unaware that the day of destruction had come.

q: What was the Pharisees’ attitude about their own righteousness and about other people?
a: They thought they were more righteous than other people.

q: What was the Pharisee’s attitude about his own righteousness and about other people?
a: He thought he was not sinful like other people.

q: How did the people respond after seeing the blind man healed?
a: They glorified and praised God.

q: How did Jesus say these scribes would be judged?
a: He said that they will receive a greater condemnation.
